source_strata_definition: Disjoint source_family/kind/namespace groups; null family means absent. Each counter sums to its manifest total. chunks_jsonl_bytes is the exact serialized file size, including metadata and newlines.

statistics_definitions.canonical_token_count: Complete document tokens counted once, without overlap or specials.
statistics_definitions.chunk_canonical_token_count: Sum of chunk canonical spans, including 64-position overlaps.
statistics_definitions.chunk_text_bytes: Sum of UTF-8 chunk text bytes, including overlap; excludes JSON framing.
statistics_definitions.chunk_token_count: Sum of retokenized chunk tokens, including overlap, without prefixes/specials.
statistics_definitions.document_count: Input documents, including empty token streams.
statistics_definitions.empty_token_document_count: Documents whose complete canonical text has no tokens.
statistics_definitions.inference_token_count: Sum of chunk inference tokens, including passage prefix and specials.
statistics_definitions.nonparagraph_split_count: All nonfinal emitted ends that are not paragraph boundaries.
statistics_definitions.oversized_paragraph_count: Canonical paragraph token intervals longer than 384, counted once.
statistics_definitions.oversized_paragraph_split_count: Nonfinal emitted ends strictly inside a canonical paragraph longer than 384; one event per end, never recounting a split because its tokens overlap.
